::: {#xp-guide-suzhou-library}

::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

Resource source: Suzhou Library services outside the University.

:::

::: {.contribution authors="unknown" status="unverified"}

Want to read books from Dushu Lake Library or borrow from Suzhou Library, but they are too far away? Borrow through the mini-program! Suzhou Library books can be delivered to Dushu Lake Library for collection **free of charge**, while Dushu Lake Library books can be delivered right to the entrance of the university library. Search WeChat for the mini-program "苏图借书". Your medical insurance card is also a citizen card and can be used to borrow books. If you already have one, link it directly and avoid the card-opening fee, then follow the instructions in the mini-program.

:::
